title: Geologic Map of the Eadytown Quadrangle, Berkeley, Clarendon and Orangeburg Counties, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2010, Geologic Map of the Eadytown Quadrangle, Berkeley, Clarendon and Orangeburg Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-171, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet. Symbols: Qcb on its description line; Qsf, Qrt, PEs, PEwh, PPw printed after their descriptions (inferred); QHfw ('QHiw') and QPwtb ('QPwib') corrected from the text layer (inferred, unclear). Ladson ('Pid') and Penholoway ('[ orp |') symbols garbled, not recorded. The Toney Bay Member description begins 'The Waccamaw formation is', recorded as printed. Text cites Brooks and others 2002; the reference list gives 2001. Legend-only features (contact line type, drill-hole symbol) not recorded. The sheet says its products are provided 'as is' without warranty.
SUBSURFACE: not held: maximum drilled thicknesses in named drill holes (8-208, 45-214, 38-208, 38-207, 8-163, 8-181), stored as unit thickness without depths or elevations; drill logs on file at SCGS. Sections A-A' (VE 100) and B-B' (VE 50) have no legible distances or unit elevations; elevation scales to 100 ft. Uppermost elevations (stored as surfaces) have no printed datum or point location. Datum: horizontal 1927 North American Datum; contour interval 5 feet.
